objective: Close real crash windows with an ED-owned fsynced control journal, preserved pending attempts, model/runtime binding and complete checkpoint envelope validation; retain generic simulation/seed runner and acknowledged parts.
interface_contract: Capture control v2; compiled model/runtime source and actual toolchain/features bind recovery. Initial and per-completed-replication checkpoints fsync+atomic rename+directory sync before acknowledgment. Known pending attempt parts may be explicitly archived on resume, never silently deleted/adopted; completed parts validated/preserved. Valid completed capture without final batch document can finalize without rerun. This is process-crash local-filesystem/completed-replication recovery, not within-run or hardware power-loss certification.
steps: Meaningful3test red: missing model binding, unchecked envelope, complete-manifest crash rejection
Implement ED durable checkpoint commit around existing generic runner; preserve scientific/seed ordering and default CPU guards
Add real child-process kill at part/checkpoint/manifest windows, 1/2/4worker recovery and idempotence; error/sync/checkpoint drift negatives
Review exact committed source and run combined native/independent reader/full policy/hosted gates before R11 phase acceptance

verification.oracle: Actual crash-window recovery preserves acknowledged hashes/counts/seeds and fails before mutation on invalid model/envelopes; old fault/backpressure controls remain active.

acceptance: Real process-kill evidence separate from injected EIO and power-loss claims
stop_conditions: Any scientific or generic engine change required
size_exception: One serial durability contract spans coordinator/journal/store/native fault tests and mandatory evidence/build binding; no generic core or upstream writes.
